components.name: Evidence boundary disclosure
components.description: Native disclosure keeps scope and limitations available beneath the comparison.
components.html:
What does this result establish?

The result is limited to the synthetic sphere, this controller and the two-second window; slow drift remains. Longer holds, contact switching and new validation conditions are the next tests. Real fingertip calibration and a complete autonomous RSI loop remain unverified.

narrative.overview:
The homepage shares the existing dexterous-simulation guide's warm paper, charcoal text, muted green links and serif opening title. A quiet reading rail, comfortable line lengths and fine rules establish hierarchy. Open rows and restrained labels keep attention on the research and its evidence. Behind the opening copy, every curated concept, canonical solver or numerical option and cross-experiment research synthesis forms a semantic field that resolves during the first scroll. Hovering one item sharpens the field and enlarges it while the others remain readable; concepts open the searchable atlas and syntheses open their articles directly. Engine registrations remain separate context.

This system governs the Chinese and English research homepages, concept entries and their MuJoCo learning route. The learning surface extends the same palette and type character with chapter navigation and native reading controls; its tokens are named separately so the homepage keeps its established hierarchy. The existing article is the visual reference; its content and styles remain independently maintained. Other Sphinx pages and the separate web application retain their own design systems.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and charcoal, with restrained green reading accents.
A serif opening title beside a desktop reading rail; navigation wraps above the title on smaller screens.
A scroll-revealed first-screen concept field with individual hover focus that opens into a native searchable atlas and stable bilingual terms.
Open sections and ruled reading rows, with hierarchy carried by spacing and type.
Original experiment media, native controls and explicit evidence boundaries.
The physical-validation boundary closes the study path after experiments, findings and continuation links.
A MuJoCo learning column with chapter navigation, explicit reading bookmarks and small teaching interactions.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Interface color organizes reading; recorded experiment colors retain their original meaning.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Use spacing, type and fine rules to separate content without enclosing it in raised panels.

dos: Do keep the homepage aligned with the article's warm paper, serif opening title and green links.
Do let spacing, hierarchy and open rows explain the page before adding secondary labels.
Do resolve the concept field during the first scroll, focus one hovered term, and keep a visible non-JavaScript path to the complete concept index.
Do draw only the selected concept’s local relationships and keep every term a stable bilingual link.
Do close the homepage research path with the physical-validation boundary before the contact footer.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and complete GIF, figure and disclosure access without JavaScript.
Do maintain Chinese/English parity, on-site learning links and original evidence provenance.
Do preserve explicit reading bookmarks and distinguish teaching calculations, sourced MuJoCo 4 changes and native measurements; retain the detailed courses' pinned baseline.
donts: Don't restore the homepage's old blue-white centered hero, filled action buttons or rounded promotional panels.
Don't restyle the article, unrelated Sphinx pages or the separate web application through this reading system.
Don't animate every concept independently or use resting font size to imply popularity.
Don't show a complete relation graph at rest or wrap concept entries in cards and shadows.
Don't replace recorded evidence with generated imagery, autoplay the replay or imply an autonomous result.
Don't invent component variants, radius scales or motion tokens absent from the implementation.
